title: Deferred collector export for Private deployments and quota reconciliation
creator: Ethan Choi
description:
Problem: Private/VPC customers deploy on-prem edge collectors that operate in partially or fully air-gapped environments. These collectors buffer usage events and periodically export bundled manifests to the control plane. When exports are delayed, reordered, or re-sent (retries), we currently see two classes of correctness issues: (1) duplicate counting of token/embedding usage, and (2) quota enforcement drift where rate limits and quota windows in the control plane get out of sync with actual client behavior. Both can lead to billing inaccuracies and incorrect throttling.

Goal: Implement a robust, idempotent, and verifiable deferred export protocol and reconciliation flow so that delayed collector uploads do not cause double-charging or incorrect quota enforcement. Provide clear operational signals and a migration plan for existing on-prem customers.

Proposed solution summary:
- Export bundle format: include a monotonic collector watermark, bundle_uuid (v4), window_start/window_end timestamps, event_count, and per-event sequence numbers.
- Ingestion contract: control plane accepts bundles and applies idempotency by (collector_id, bundle_uuid) and achieves monotonic merge by watermark. If watermark <= last_committed_watermark for that collector, mark bundle as replayed and drop duplicates.
- At-least-once durability with reconciliation: where duplicate partial windows exist, reconcile by de-duplicating per-event sequence numbers and applying a last-seen watermark and delta-merge to the ledger.
- Quota enforcement alignment: compute quota usage from canonical ledger state; support a transient reconciliation flag that temporarily relaxes strict per-request throttling for collectors behind reconciling windows while maintaining burst safety using token-bucket clamps.
- Observability: new metrics and traces: collector_bundle_ingested, collector_bundle_replayed, collector_watermark_gap_seconds, ledger_delta_applied, reconciliation_actions_count, and a reconciliation_health per-customer dashboard.
- Security: bundles are signed with HMAC using customer-provided key during export; ingestion validates signature and timestamp skew.

Trade-offs and notes:
- Exactly-once on the wire is extremely costly (distributed consensus across air-gapped collectors). We choose deterministic idempotency + reconciliation which is simpler operationally and performant.
- During long reconciliations, user-facing quota enforcement may be temporarily permissive for short bursts; this is documented in release notes and controlled by rollout knobs.

Migration path:
1) Collector-side: ship a collector patch to produce bundle_uuid and monotonic watermark, with HMAC signing. Backfill mode to re-emit last 24h in new format.
2) Control-plane: add bundle ingestion endpoint with idempotency table, reconciliation worker, and consumer-facing reconciliation dashboard.
3) Gradual rollout: opt-in per-customer followed by forced cutover after 30 days.

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field.

Operational runbooks and PR links will be appended to comments as they are created.
acceptance_criteria: Control plane does not increase billed usage when a collector re-sends an identical bundle_uuid for the same watermark
Ledger audit: for any 72-hour window, ledger delta before vs after reconciliation is stable and explainable with reconciliation actions recorded
No false-positive quota blocks for customers once collector patch is deployed and reconciliation completes for a 48-hour test window
Automated integration test that simulates out-of-order bundle uploads, duplicates, and partial overlaps with >95% pass rate
Dashboard surfaces collector_watermark_gap_seconds and reconciliations older than 1h trigger alerts
implementation_notes: Schema: add collector_watermarks table (collector_id, last_committed_watermark, last_bundle_uuid, last_seen_at) - use idempotency keys keyed by (collector_id,bundle_uuid)
Reconciliation worker: stream new bundles to a reconcile queue, run idempotent de-dup by sequence number, then write atomic ledger delta in a single DB transaction
Rate-limit interaction: when a collector reports watermark lag > 10m, flip per-customer quota to reconciliation-mode token-bucket with reduced refill to avoid abuse
Testing: unit tests for de-dup logic, e2e harness to spin local collector emulator and control-plane ingest, load test with 500 collectors emitting 1k events each
Security: require collector HMAC key rotation support; encryption-at-rest is already in place for bundles stored in staging buckets

2025-02-27 - Mariana Ortega: Security approved HMAC flow; added key-rotation step to migration. Marked security_review_required = true.

2025-03-03 - Ethan Choi: Implemented ingestion endpoint and idempotency table. Running integration harness against local collector emulator. Observed a 0.8% ledger delta mismatch due to timestamp rounding—fix landed in PR #5286.
